original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Framed-level necessity of PR1194's H2-sem condition 2: proof-role extraction of H1 in the interleaved scalar-interface lemma, plus instance admission of the F4-shaped target-feeding-helper wrap on the pinned selected R439 word through the merged h2sem package's unmodified machinery, with three new target-class negative controls (uncompensated feed, wrong compensation target, span crossing the fed target's own gate).
scope_change_reason: The card's headline experiment (one replacement H2/K implication for a helper-mixing word) is completed on main by research/r439-copyshare-h2sem-admission for helper-feeding wraps; this session takes that merged package's recorded second open next question (is condition 2 needed at the framed level) on the same word and machinery, which the card's acceptance gate admits as a scoped local result.
bottleneck_link: The result does not itself change the selected moment; it enlarges the admissible wrap class for the selected bit word's D section, where the next priced bit constructions are selected, and closes a recorded open question on the inherited interface contract.
stop_rule: Stop after the admission verdict (every semantic premise and conclusion component passes under the weakened contract, or one exact failing component on dirty columns is recorded) plus the target-class negative controls; no priced search and no census extension.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json: PASS_R439_H2SEM_COND2_FRAMED_TRANSFER; all 661 basis columns replayed through the unchanged xcheck_p.py; predecessor F4 record reproduced field for field (flags, reads 18154); conditional admission with controls=6 and no new kappa; reproduce via python3 -B research/r439-h2sem-cond2-framed-transfer/verify.py.
